high_level_description: The image depicts a woman posing in front of ancient ruins from the top of a hill. She is sitting on a stone wall, wearing a white outfit consisting of a long-sleeved shirt and wide-legged pants, along with white sandals. She has a sunhat on her head, which suggests it might be a sunny day. The background features a panoramic view of a cityscape with numerous buildings spread across the landscape, surrounded by greenery and hills. The ruins behind her appear to be part of an ancient amphitheater or similar structure, characterized by large stone arches and columns.
